quotes.text: Partner Center isn't just a reseller portal. It's the central hub for your entire Microsoft partnership.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up the episode's core thesis in one line.

quotes.text: Use the role-based access control to give each person exactly what they need and nothing more. That prevents security headaches down the road.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear least-privilege recommendation for Partner Center roles.

quotes.text: One thing I strongly recommend, create a break-glass account. This is an emergency admin account in Microsoft Enter ID that has global admin privileges, but isn't tied to any individual user.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete best practice that prevents being locked out of the partner account.

quotes.text: If you're automating things through the Partner Center API, watch out for rate limiting. Microsoft throttles API calls if you make too many too fast.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical warning for partners automating Partner Center.

quotes.text: If your automation isn't MFA ready, it will break. Simple as that. MFA is becoming the standard everywhere and Partner Center is no exception.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Direct call to action on the MFA requirement for Partner Center APIs.

chapters.title: The old way versus the new way
The FY26 benefit tiers and what you get
Common pitfalls and how to avoid them

takeaways: Microsoft Partner Center is the single hub where any Microsoft partner, from a one-person consultancy to a large reseller, manages benefits, incentives, customers and certifications.
The FY26 benefits refresh groups partners into Launch, Core and Expanded tiers, with internal-use licenses, Azure credits, security tools and, through designations, Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses.
Avoid common pitfalls by setting up under your primary Entra ID tenant, using role-based access and a break-glass account, checking earnings reports and making API automation MFA-ready.
hook: Many partners think Partner Center is only a portal for big resellers and leave benefits, credits and incentives unused. This episode explains Microsoft Partner Center for consultants, managed service providers and software companies: who it is for, what the Launch, Core and Expanded tiers include, how to set it up safely and which upcoming API and MFA changes to prepare for.
